types.name: action
types.label: Action
types.description: A call-to-action link rendered as a button.

fields.name: icon
fields.definition: blocks.CharBlock(required=False, label="Icon", help_text="Lucide icon name, e.g. arrow-right.")

fields.name: magnetic
fields.definition: blocks.ChoiceBlock(choices=[("inherit", "Inherit"), ("on", "On"), ("off", "Off")], required=False, default="inherit", label="Magnetic", help_text="Pull the button towards the pointer on hover (mouse only). Inherit follows the site setting.")

fields.name: icon
fields.definition: blocks.CharBlock(required=False, label="Icon", help_text="Lucide icon name, e.g. arrow-right.")

fields.name: values
fields.definition: blocks.ListBlock(blocks.CharBlock(label="Text"), default=[], label="Values", help_text="One value per column. Use 'yes' / 'no' for check and cross icons.")

fields.name: meta
fields.definition: blocks.CharBlock(required=False, label="Meta", help_text="e.g. date or reading time")

fields.name: options
fields.definition: blocks.ListBlock(blocks.CharBlock(label="Text"), default=[], label="Options", help_text="Options for select fields.")

types.name: navColumn
types.label: Navigation column
types.description: A titled column of links inside a mega menu panel.

types.name: navGroup
types.label: Navigation group
types.description: A top-level navigation entry. With links it opens a dropdown; with columns it opens a mega menu panel.

fields.name: columns
fields.definition: ItemListBlock(NavColumnItem(), max_num=4, default=[], label="Columns", help_text="Titled columns of links. When set, the group opens a mega menu panel instead of a dropdown.")

fields.name: feature
fields.definition: ItemListBlock(CardItem(), max_num=1, default=[], label="Feature", help_text="Optional featured card at the end of the mega menu panel.")

fields.name: scrollEffect
fields.definition: blocks.ChoiceBlock(choices=[("none", "None"), ("parallax", "Parallax"), ("zoom", "Zoom"), ("fade", "Fade")], required=False, default="none", label="Scroll effect", help_text="Moves the media with the page scroll: parallax drift, a slow zoom, or a fade at the edges.")

fields.name: theme
fields.definition: blocks.ChoiceBlock(choices=[("light", "Light"), ("dark", "Dark"), ("brand", "Brand"), ("muted", "Muted"), ("blue", "Blue"), ("green", "Green"), ("orange", "Orange"), ("rose", "Rose"), ("violet", "Violet")], required=False, label="Theme", help_text="Applies a theme class to this block only.")

fields.name: anchor
fields.definition: blocks.CharBlock(required=False, label="Anchor", help_text="Optional id for in-page links, e.g. 'pricing'.")

fields.name: animation
fields.definition: blocks.ChoiceBlock(choices=[("inherit", "Inherit"), ("none", "None"), ("fadeUp", "Fade up"), ("fadeIn", "Fade in"), ("scaleIn", "Scale in"), ("slideFromLeft", "Slide from left"), ("slideFromRight", "Slide from right"), ("blurIn", "Blur in")], required=False, default="inherit", label="Animation", help_text="Entrance animation played once when the block scrolls into view. Inherit follows the site setting.")

fields.name: animationStagger
fields.definition: blocks.ChoiceBlock(choices=[("inherit", "Inherit"), ("on", "On"), ("off", "Off")], required=False, default="inherit", label="Stagger items", help_text="Reveal the block's items one after another instead of all at once.")

fields.name: headingAnimation
fields.definition: blocks.ChoiceBlock(choices=[("inherit", "Inherit"), ("none", "None"), ("words", "Words"), ("characters", "Characters"), ("lines", "Lines"), ("typewriter", "Typewriter"), ("scramble", "Scramble")], required=False, default="inherit", label="Heading animation", help_text="Reveals the block title by words, characters or lines, types it out, or scrambles it into place.")
